row.body: LIVE-COUNT-1 (2026-11-25, Session: session_0156nqDvJ5oNPSCVZzS8cYKL): /live How much code ships read 0 in every row. The snapshot builds it from one gh pr list GraphQL call; when that call fails or times out, _sh returns empty and 0 is published as fact. A REST fallback now fills the count, and transparency --probe-merged fails the workflow when /live shows 0 while GitHub has merges in the last 7 days.
